reason: The hypothesis transfers the well-known interface-pinning mechanism from γ/γ′ interfaces in high-entropy superalloys (P1, P2, P5, P10) and serrated grain boundaries (P15, P19, P20, P29, P32) to a new system: engineered multilayer coatings of dissimilar high-entropy alloys. It combines the concept of compositional gradients and stress fields at interfaces with the multilayer architecture, which is not proposed or studied in any passage. The specific intervention (multilayer vs. monolithic of same overall composition) and the focus on coherency and misfit strain as mediators are new.
